claims.claim: All Hyundai and Kia genuine spare parts and accessories are available (implying this headlight is a genuine Hyundai/Kia part)
claims.evidence: No brand markings, logos, or part numbers are visible in the photo; witness did not report any identifying text on the lens or housing

claims.claim: Item is new or fairly used (implying good condition)
claims.evidence: Witness only saw the lens exterior; no close-up of cracks, fogging, wiring, or bulb condition

risks.proof: Photo showing part number or OEM sticker on the headlight housing, or seller statement matched to a verifiable part list
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified-fitment part, lowest tier for 'headlight assembly, fitment unconfirmed'

risks.proof: Full front-facing photo showing orientation relative to vehicle centerline, or seller labeling L/R
risks.if_unproven: priced as unspecified side, buyer assumes risk of mismatch

risks.proof: Close-up of embossed logo/part number on lens or housing
risks.if_unproven: priced as aftermarket/generic, not genuine OEM

risks.risk: Internal lens condition (fogging, cracks, water damage) unknown
risks.proof: Clear photo from multiple angles including underside and internal lens surface, ideally backlit
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only verified, functional condition unproven, worst case treated as damaged

risks.risk: Wiring, connectors, and bulb functionality unverified
risks.proof: Short video clip of headlight powered on, showing both low/high beam and turn signal illumination

risks.risk: Completeness of mounting brackets and hardware unknown
risks.proof: Photo of rear/mounting side showing brackets, clips, and adjustment screws
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, missing hardware assumed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any part number, OEM logo, or sticker on the headlight
Photo from the rear/mounting side showing brackets and connector ports
Short video of the headlight powered on showing all light functions
Photo confirming left or right side orientation relative to vehicle
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a car headlight assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified fitment, side, OEM status, and untested electrical/mechanical condition) pending the listed proofs.
